comments.author: @subterfusion4005
comments.text:
East NC boiled taters:
5lbs taters
4 yeller onions
1/4 cup bacon grease
1 20 oz bottle ketchup
1/4 cup Texas Pete
1/3 cup sugar
Salt n pepper to taste

Cut up taters n onions, cover with water.  Stir in the rest and bring to a boil.  Simmer till taters are soft, 30-40 min.   Keep on very low heat till serving.
